name: Pumpkin Spice Draft Latte
summary: Seasonal pumpkin spice Draft Latte at 18 g of sugar, with 190 mg of caffeine and 7 g of protein per 11 oz can at 170 calories.
tastingNotes: I drank this cold from the fridge. The texture is the reason to buy it. It is thick and creamy, closer to real cream than most cans this size. My husband took one sip and said it tasted like he was eating pumpkin bread, and that is exactly it: the pumpkin tastes baked, not syrupy. The coffee is bright but mild, so the spice and the milk lead. It is sweet, and there is a faint aftertaste I could not place. It is not an added sweetener doing that, because cane sugar is the only one on the label, and half the 18 g of sugar comes from the milk and the pumpkin. I liked it. I would also happily pour it into a hot toddy, which tells you it drinks more like dessert than morning coffee.
